summary.text: Erin Paré is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 37 since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Her background includes work as a public policy consultant, business owner, and founder of a nonprofit organization.

paragraphs.text: Erin Paré was born in Washington, D.C.
She earned a B.A. in government and international politics in 2000 and an M.A. in international commerce and policy in 2002, both from George Mason University.

Her career experience includes work as a senior account executive, director of the Regulatory Improvement Council, public policy consultant, business owner, and founder and director of a 501(c)(3) nonprofit.
She has served as president of the Holly Ridge Elementary School PTA, as an Army family readiness group leader, and as vice chair of the Holly Springs Board of Adjustment.
Paré assumed office in the state House on January 1, 2021, succeeding Sydney Batch.
In the 2023-2024 session she chaired the Health Committee and was vice chair of the Appropriations on Health and Human Services and Energy and Public Utilities committees.
The Republican primary for her seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
